question:
The database is an advertising management system, whose main function is to manage the broadcast of advertisements and track the advertising broadcast data of customers. The following is a specific description of the requirements:
Advertising management: The system can manage the basic information of multiple advertisements, including the name, content, duration, etc. of the advertisement. Each advertisement can have a different broadcast schedule.

Customer management: The system can record the basic information of customers, including name, email and contact number.

Advertising broadcast tracking: The system tracks the detailed information of each advertisement broadcast, including the start time, end time, broadcast duration, ratings, etc. of the advertisement.
ddl:
-- Schema for database: rschema_0285
CREATE TABLE `advertisements` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `duration` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `broadcast_schedules` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `advertisement_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `start_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `end_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `duration` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `advertisement_id` (`advertisement_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `broadcast_schedules_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`advertisement_id`) REFERENCES `advertisements` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `customers` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `contact_number` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `broadcast_data` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `advertisement_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `customer_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `start_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `end_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `ratings` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `advertisement_id` (`advertisement_id`),
  KEY `customer_id` (`customer_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `broadcast_data_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`advertisement_id`) REFERENCES `advertisements` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `broadcast_data_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_id`) REFERENCES `customers` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
